headlines.title: Sigma-locally-finite basis criterion
headlines.text:
**Sigma-locally-finite basis criterion**
([`TopologicalSpace.metrizableSpace_of_sigmaLocallyFinite_isTopologicalBasis`](https://github.com/FormalFrontier/metrization/blob/9c7cf0d82ab3c69a759c43e2ab6a246d537b7235/Metrization/LocallyFinite.lean)).
A T₃ space is metrizable if it has an open basis in countably many locally finite
indexed levels. Each level may have an arbitrary index type; local finiteness
counts the original indices, including repetitions.

headlines.title: Metric converse
headlines.text:
**Metric converse**
([`TopologicalSpace.exists_sigmaLocallyFinite_isTopologicalBasis`](https://github.com/FormalFrontier/metrization/blob/9c7cf0d82ab3c69a759c43e2ab6a246d537b7235/Metrization/LocallyFinite.lean)).
Every metrizable space has an open basis in countably many locally finite
levels, each indexed by the points of the space.

headlines.title: Closed metrizable neighbourhood-cover criterion
headlines.text:
**Closed metrizable neighbourhood-cover criterion**
([`TopologicalSpace.metrizableSpace_of_locallyFinite_isClosed_interior_cover`](https://github.com/FormalFrontier/metrization/blob/9c7cf0d82ab3c69a759c43e2ab6a246d537b7235/Metrization/LocallyFinite.lean)).
A space is metrizable if it has a locally finite family of closed subsets whose
interiors cover the space and each of which is metrizable in its original
subtype topology. No ambient separation assumption is required.
